verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI lets users get rapid answers from their inbox without remembering senders or keywords (e.g. "where is the q2 offsite", "when is my flight"). Its official MCP server also connects inbox and calendar to Claude or ChatGPT for thread summaries and workflows across both. That clearly covers the core of asking questions across mail and calendar, but several parts of the story are not documented. missing for 10: documentation that answers are grounded with source citations or links to the underlying messages, explicit support for "what's outstanding" or open-item queries, explicit calendar querying within Ask AI itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.

Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
